(II)--one of the nine sons of सावर्णि. वा. १००. २२.

--a class of Manes who reside in regions belong- ing to Kardama प्रजापति, descendants of Pulaha; विरजा, wife of नहुष was their mindborn daughter; largely wor- shipped by वैश्यस्. Br. II. २८. १९; III. १०. ९३-5; भा.
